"""Root-owned native validate/save/history/check sequence; inert unless --apply is supplied."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import yaml
from common import (
    BASE,
    ROOT,
    TARGET,
    TARGET_SHA,
    bind,
    current,
    external_new,
    now,
    read,
    run,
    sha,
    verify,
    write,
)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--assembly", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    current()
    assembly = read(args.assembly)
    verify(assembly["review"])
    doc = yaml.safe_load(Path(assembly["review"]["path"]).read_bytes())
    assert doc["reviewer"]["independence"] == "self_review"
    assert doc["source"]["git_revision"] == BASE and sha(ROOT / TARGET) == TARGET_SHA
    for item in doc["source"]["inputs"]:
        assert sha(ROOT / item["path"]) == item["sha256"], item["path"]
    output = external_new(args.output)
    if not args.apply:
        print(
            {
                "status": "dry_run_passed",
                "planned": ["validate", "save", "history", "validate-history", "check"],
                "maintained_writes": False,
                "review": assembly["review"],
            }
        )
        return
    output.mkdir()
    run("validate", ["scripts/record_review.py", "validate", assembly["review"]["path"]], output)
    saved = __import__("json").loads(
        run(
            "save",
            ["scripts/record_review.py", "save", "--content", assembly["review"]["path"]],
            output,
            mutation=True,
            apply=True,
        )
    )
    review_path = Path(saved["review"])
    markdown = Path(saved["markdown"])
    assert review_path.is_relative_to(ROOT / "reviews/structured")
    assert yaml.safe_load(review_path.read_bytes()) == doc
    details = (
        "Added the exact accepted full L-lyxose record (111 edges"
        ", 66 references, ten endpoint qualifiers), "
        "original-derived canonical authority delta and reviewed bounded native adapters. "
        "Independent original science, scientific successor and c"
        "anonical audit are retained; this finalization is author"
        "-prepared self-review packaging. "
        "Issues 438/439 are accepted source-backed corrections, not yet a claim of GitHub closure. "
        "Actual maintained gates, preservation and static QA are bound in the new saved review "
        + doc["review_id"]
        + ". Native saved review: "
        + str(review_path.relative_to(ROOT))
        + ". "
        "No source-exhaustion or public-release licensing readine"
        "ss claim. PR/CI/merge and branch cleanup remain root-own"
        "ed."
    )
    result = run(
        "history",
        [
            "scripts/new_history_record.py",
            "--kind",
            "record",
            "--slug",
            "l-lyxose-degradation",
            "--target-root",
            "data/pathways",
            "--event",
            "CREATE",
            "--outcome",
            "changed",
            "--summary",
            "Add source-qualified L-lyxose degradation with accepted review corrections",
            "--details",
            details,
            "--actor-name",
            "codex",
            "--actor-type",
            "ai_agent",
            "--agent-tool",
            "codex",
            "--issue",
            "438",
            "--issue",
            "439",
        ],
        output,
        mutation=True,
        apply=True,
    )
    history = ROOT / result.decode().strip().splitlines()[-1]
    assert history.is_relative_to(ROOT / "history/records/l-lyxose-degradation")
    run("validate-history", ["scripts/validate_history.py", str(history)], output)
    check = __import__("json").loads(
        run("check", ["scripts/record_review.py", "check", "--base", BASE], output)
    )
    assert check["valid_reviews"] == 102, check
    for item in doc["source"]["inputs"]:
        assert sha(ROOT / item["path"]) == item["sha256"], item["path"]
    write(
        output / "native-completion.json",
        {
            "status": "saved_review_and_history_checked",
            "at": now(),
            "assembly": bind(args.assembly),
            "review_id": doc["review_id"],
            "canonical_yaml": bind(review_path),
            "canonical_markdown": bind(markdown),
            "history": bind(history),
            "check_result": check,
            "actual_receipts": {
                label: bind(output / (label + "-execution.json"))
                for label in ["validate", "save", "history", "validate-history", "check"]
            },
            "remaining": "Archive actual finalization receipts, bind exact later a"
            "dditions, rerun bounded preservation, then seal.",
        },
    )
    print(bind(output / "native-completion.json"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
